limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. No Wall-Sun-Sun prime is asserted to exist. The theorem is stated for q != 5 to match the recent source lemma being corrected; no claim is made that q=5 is intrinsically excluded from every analogous density formula. The result does not settle Conjecture 4.4, the universal Sophie Germain uniqueness conjecture, or whether external witnesses occur in the hypothetical Wall-Sun-Sun branch. The main residual literature risk is unindexed contemporaneous commentary or correction concerning the recent arXiv preprint. The prime-power lifting law itself is classical; the claimed contribution is the exact residue-class density theorem and its consequences for S(q). No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
provenance: Exact prime-power witness densities for the Fibonacci-totient residue-class set S(q) introduced in arXiv:2604.17847v3, obtained from classical Fibonacci rank and p-adic lifting laws.
record_title: Prime-power witness densities in Fibonacci-totient residue classes
